rating_policy: No automatic score rise from builds/test counts; full product overall remains unscored until critical evidence exists.
schedule: No automation active; one bounded source batch per requested run, then validation/review. No overnight or calendar promise.

batches.title: Truthful playback and update states
acceptance_criteria: Current/Playing/Paused/Buffering/Error labels agree across mini/full/queue and accessibility descriptions.
Model authenticated Disabled/NoCompatible/Available separately from unavailable/offline/error; no unsigned404 treated as trusted disabled metadata.
Retain manual checks, weekly cooldown, source/signature/data boundaries; no public activation without approval.
batches.notes: Owner-approved code41 installed with 29 unchanged prelaunch saved-file hashes. Queue Paused/Playing/Paused and unavailable-update Retry/return observed; other phases and full acceptance pending. No rating increase.

batches.title: Compact secondary UI without losing controls
acceptance_criteria: Reduce repeated header/card/copy weight in Home,You,queue and Sound Studio using measured viewport budgets.
Retain every action,48dp independent targets, large-text expansion and accessible disclosure of advanced details.
Capture matched411dp reference and320/360/landscape/large-font comparisons; preserve active/draft sound behavior.
batches.notes: Compact production settings/mix/queue/Sound layouts; all controls/art sizes retained. 40 new UI cases compiled only; rendered/device acceptance NOT_RUN.

batches.title: Source-correct artwork quality
acceptance_criteria: Measure requested/cached/decoded/displayed art sizes; recover sharper legitimate same-source imagery where available.
No audio URL/quality/recording changes, invented album identity or unbounded network/decode work.
Verify stale/deleted/source-change races, missing art fallback and narrow/large player sharpness; keep unavailable quality honest.

batches.title: Four-theme and motion consistency
acceptance_criteria: Review every theme at Home/Search/Library/You/player/queue/offline/dialog states with measured contrast.
Preserve matte identity, accessible selected/disabled/error states and reduced-motion/focus/keyboard behavior.
Measure transitions/frame pacing before duration changes; investigate Sound Studio dump137 without labeling it an app crash.

batches.title: Search offline and lyrics journey finish
acceptance_criteria: Exercise live public and saved/local queries, versions/cancellation/stale results and exact source identity.
Align offline/import/download/error UI and actionable readiness/retry copy; measure network/receive/write separately without universal Mbps promise.
Complete owned-LRC import/review/editor/follow guidance; preserve every supported source and exclude unauthorized lyrics/audio workflows.

batches.title: Older Android language and accessibility finish
acceptance_criteria: Backport classic text sizing on API23–25 without removing the native fallback; validate bounded text/wrapping.
Finish prioritized native/advanced English/Bangla resource coverage while preserving user/provider text and data schemas.
Use approved API23/24/26/modern and hardware/input/TalkBack/font profiles; grade only actually executed cases.

batches.title: Recovery sharing and release readiness
acceptance_criteria: Verify share/file-provider/picker/rotation/cancel/name-conflict and data-preserving receipts with disposable fixtures.
Exercise recovery/upload/restore/account-switch only under explicitly approved disposable-account scope; preserve existing consent and private reporting.
Prepare reviewable stable metadata/APK rollback and release artifacts; activation/public binary/main merge remain explicit owner approvals.

batches.title: Final measured acceptance and re-rating
acceptance_criteria: Close original219 plus supplemental/new cases with exact source/APK/signer and device artifacts; repair demonstrated critical/high failures.
Run locked eight-listener tasks and required two-hour/route/offline/performance/battery evidence; retain every failure and limitation.
Re-rate original full weighted rubric;>=9.5 requires no core area below9 and no unknown critical gate. Keep release GO separate.
